verdict.rationale: A fast edit-run loop is a fair question for a JavaScript game framework, but nothing in the evidence documents hot reload, a dev server with live reload, or near-instant preview after a script change. The CLI project templates [phaser-docs-21] don't mention reload behavior. The Editor's real-time filter tweaking [phaser-docs-27] is a visual-inspector feature, not script-change reloading, so it earns no credit here.
